hypothesis: A candidate semantic scoring process can distinguish source-supported requested facts from clear support/condition/measurement failures.
partition_scope: Both partitions use already-inspected development material. Distinct from each other for future judge-example/prompt fitting; not an untouched population test and not the reserved reader evaluation split.

critical_types_with_two_examples_each: valid target gap plus unsupported partial literature claim

label_contract: Review requested-fact lists, candidate assertions and own evidence before judge calls. Bind source bytes and distinguish fabricated values from support failures. Quarantine disputed cases before lock; report exclusions. Model-assisted labels are provisional, human fields remain unfilled until person reviews.
judge_contract: Freeze judge model/revision, prompt, tools, token/request limits and decoding before validation. Labels from the validation partition never become in-context examples or judge prompt-tuning inputs. Grade facts, not string overlap.

expected_scores.supported_partial: C from the frozen requested-fact labels

failure_rule: Any threshold breach fails the gate. Stop before optimization. Record failure; any prompt/reward/judge change informed by this check makes it design data, requiring fresh development-only validation cases. Never use the reserved reader questions/papers to repair this judge.
interpretation: Zero observed errors among32 deliberately clear fixtures is only a sentinel gate; do not claim a population false-positive rate, validated automatic semantic correctness or improvement from training.
